card.name: Word before examination, partway through words
card.fires_on: The word just before a word it predicts, most often 'skin' or 'physical' before 'examination', or the first part of a longer word such as 'neuro' before 'leptic'. Seen in warnings about periodic checks and in split-up names.

modes.label: Exam type before 'examination'
modes.description: A word like skin or physical that sits right before 'examination' in monitoring advice.
modes.example: Perform periodic<< skin>> examination for patients who are at increased risk

modes.label: Inside split words
modes.description: A first or middle piece of a longer word or name that is still unfinished.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Chew or crush Vel<<ph>>oro tablets, do not swallow whole.
